geo_aeo.answer_first_block: Cloudflare Workers is an Edge Computing (Serverless) platform executing code directly at global CDN points of presence. Unlike AWS Lambda running Docker containers, Workers utilizes Chrome V8 Isolates to achieve near-instantaneous 0ms cold starts and extreme resource efficiency for ultra-low latency APIs and semantic edge caching.
